interpretation: A transitively redundant direct import adds no new closure. When its constants are directly used, retain it as an explicit API contract unless an owner deliberately changes that policy.

The three transitively redundant headers without direct-origin witnesses are optional header cleanup; absence of constants alone does not prove absence of elaborator/tactic use. Their closure is already supplied by the retained imports.

SphereProjectedNoise uses derivative/product rules and ring; the full Mathlib.Tactic and InnerProductSpace.Calculus imports are broader than needed. The focused candidate compiles with FDeriv.Mul and Tactic.Ring while retaining PiL2.

CompactStateRepresentative uses measurable piecewise/subtype construction and no topological premise. The focused candidate compiles with MeasurableSpace.Constructions in place of Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic.

No remaining module has an unexplained nonredundant direct import without an exact-origin API witness after the two narrowed cases. This is a bounded pollution review, not proof that every symbol or every transitive dependency is necessary.
future_bounded_rebind: Do not apply during this review. Preserve the two candidate files and empty successful compiler logs.

If adopted, change only the two headers and verify unchanged non-import bytes. Run two focused production module checks and compare compiler-exposed signatures/definition bodies for their eight admitted declarations.

Refresh canonical full-module/source hashes, immutable source locators, publication binding digests, packet/run bindings and independent metadata-only successor receipts for the five plus three directly affected declarations; retain the old evidence.

Use existing binding validators to detect any further genuinely changed dependent metadata. Do not presume that all 69 require mathematical or blind review; unchanged mathematics, source topology, reader steps and decoder texts are reused.
